nodes.label: desktop memory - the mapping key finalization

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. Mapping-key finalization, user-decided 2026-06-12, closing the items the graph-spine decision deferred. The attribute-versus-stays-in-raw discriminator is the repetition ratio: the probe measures distinct over total per scalar field across the fuse, so shared values such as channel names, state and type become indexed attributes while per-record-unique free-form values such as title, link and description stay in raw behind references - no key entry and no per-dataset threshold tuning, because the gap is a chasm. The key's one new field is kind, on directory declarations and on the source-name space, drawn from the interpreter's universal enum with the starting set person / org / product, where product covers named systems and tools; for HERB, employee.json and customers_data.json are person and sources are product, and the interpreter-flag to which-directory-to-fuzzy-search join is literal equality on kind. The interpreter is a one-shot flagger with NO tools in a one-way pipeline - prompt in, flags out as kind plus wanted-versus-excluded - with deterministic code running the scoped distance lookup after and nothing returning to the model, one model call per query, fixed, testable as a pure function. The enum is universal as a fixed language-ontology contract while the ACTIVE subset is dataset-derived, so what can be asked about in hard fields is emergent at the join and never in the interpreter's context, with unlandable flags falling to the semantic layer and logged loudly. File-scoped values are File-node attributes, with attributes riding at the structural scope where the value sits. And eval quarantine is STRUCTURAL, not a key section, user-decided 2026-06-12 and hard: the key says NOTHING about eval, and pipeline stage 0 derives ONE view with the RAG-unsafe keys deleted, which is the only root later stages scan.
